name: om18_24_shrink_precision
description: The 0.1 shrink and the 1.0 width limit are float constants and each shrunk bound is stored as a float (OM4): x 100.0..164.0 becomes float(100.0 + 0.1f) = 100.09999847 (0x42C83333) and float(164.0 - 0.1f) = 163.89999389 (0x4323E666). A width of exactly 1.0 is not shrunk. The cells of the shrunk box follow (65..66 on x).
